researchPapers.title: Urban expansion and agricultural land loss in Indian metropolitan regions: A satellite-based analysis 2015-2023
researchPapers.abstract: This study quantifies agricultural land loss around major Indian cities using Sentinel-2 LULC data. We analyzed 12 metropolitan regions and found an average 12% reduction in agricultural land over 8 years, with hotspots around Pune, Bangalore, and Hyderabad.
researchPapers.geography: Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Nagpur

researchPapers.title: Land conversion patterns and farmer livelihood impacts in Tier-2 Indian cities
researchPapers.abstract: Qualitative and quantitative study of how rapid urbanization affects farmer incomes and social structures in smaller metropolitan areas.

researchPapers.title: Policy effectiveness of agricultural land protection acts in India
researchPapers.abstract: Comparative analysis of land protection policies across states and their effectiveness in reducing conversion rates.
findings: States with dedicated courts have 34% better outcomes
